parameters.query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, p.topics, p.language, p.custom_prompt, p.timezone
FROM users u
JOIN preferences p ON p.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.unsubscribed = false
  AND u.consent_at IS NOT NULL
  AND p.send_time IS NOT NULL
  AND (now() AT TIME ZONE p.timezone)::time >= p.send_time
  AND (now() AT TIME ZONE p.timezone)::time <  p.send_time + interval '5 minutes'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sent_log s
    WHERE s.user_id = u.id
      AND (s.sent_at AT TIME ZONE p.timezone)::date = (now() AT TIME ZONE p.timezone)::date
  );
